description: This file implements methods for DataElement and LinkedDataElement classes, including CRC32 checksum calculation, buffer get/set operations, and data copying, within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Class providing CRC32 checksum calculation over its buffer.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Class managing linked buffer segments with methods for buffer access and data copying.

methods.name: DataElement::CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a specified buffer segment.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves a segment of the buffer, handling boundary crossing via linked segments.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets a segment of the buffer, handling boundary crossing via linked segments.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another LinkedDataElement into this one, across linked segments.
